summary: Expose curated command constructors and direct flag declarations to the Printing Press verify-skill source resolver.
reason: The public package's official verify-skill check could not follow the registration hook, nested targeting helper, or pointer-binding view helpers even though the documented runtime flags existed.
validated_outcome: The source-only visibility repair preserves the existing flag names, destinations, defaults, and help text while allowing the official static verifier to resolve every documented command flag.
